subject: Day 4: Gasoline Purchase Receipt & Evidence Board
instructionString:
Editor-in-Chief,

Integrate the physical gasoline purchase receipt into the developing whistleblower story.

1. Center-align and Bold the Title: 'EVIDENCE RECORD: FUEL PURCHASE RECEIPT #0482'.
2. Add Paragraph Spacing (Space After) between testimony and receipt proof blocks.
3. Add Paragraph Spacing (Space Before) before the concluding editorial statement.

- Maya/Kiko

startingTextBlocks.text: WITNESS STATEMENT: 'I saw high-ranking administration personnel transferring gas canisters into unmarked private vehicles late at night behind the gym.'
PHYSICAL RECEIPT PROOF: 'Paragon Admin Supply Dept - 150L Unleaded Fuel - Charged to Maintenance Overhead.'
EDITORIAL CONCLUSION: Editing isn't just about grammar. It's about clarity. Right now, the truth is no longer buried in a wall of text. Mr. Reyes saw noise. I need to make him see the story.
